surface_ask.headline: New Jersey originations - HMDA 2025 reporting vintage
surface_ask.body: Reported originations for mortgage properties in New Jersey. The source grain is county observations aggregated by jurisdiction; the displayed total uses state scope. Not lenders headquartered here and not a service-terr
caveats: These are mortgage observations, not numbers of institutions, lender headquarters, licensing, or service territory.

New Jersey's complete RMLA-licensed lender roster is not acquired as a bulk universe. This is real reported HMDA mortgage activity, not a state licensing census. Missing roster records are not zero lenders.
